name: VHF airband data links
notes: ACARS on every VHF channel and VDL Mode 2 in one capture of one radio: the airband set without its ADS-B member, for a node with no second radio for 1090 MHz. Start this one for aircraft telemetry on VHF, or when airband's `second` role has no radio; add ADS-B later as its own job when a radio for 1090 MHz is free. airband_vhf_and_sos is the same with the 121.5 MHz distress channel to listen to.

wide.note: a radio that captures 130.0-137.0 MHz at once (8 MHz)
